detail.longDescription:
Yoz VPN is a simple Android VPN for quick, encrypted connections on Wi-Fi and mobile data. Connect with one tap, let Auto Select choose an available server, or select a location from the server list.

Key features:

• One-tap VPN connection and disconnection
• Auto Select for quick server selection
• Manual server selection by country
• Server latency display to compare available locations
• Encrypted VPN tunnel from your Android device to the VPN endpoint
• Support for Wi-Fi and mobile networks
• Clear connection status and a simple interface
• Referral-based premium access, where available

Yoz VPN uses Android VpnService as its core functionality to create and manage the VPN connection. Server availability and connection performance may vary based on your location, internet provider, network conditions, and server load.

A VPN can help protect data while it is being transmitted, especially on shared or public networks. It does not guarantee complete anonymity, fixed speeds, or uninterrupted availability of every online service.

Please use Yoz VPN in accordance with local laws and the terms of the services you access. For details about permissions, data handling, and privacy practices, review the Privacy Policy and the Google Play Data Safety section.
